original_mask: Observed channels within H&E tissue and original eligible (any GT marker positive) pixels
expanded_mask: Sensitivity only: observed channels within H&E tissue; processed GT zero treated as negative, not biologically verified
prediction_mask: No GT positivity gating of predictions
thresholds: Frozen pre-existing validation-only thresholds, each model own validation population/search limits; no test tuning
legacy_score_kind: Inverse transformed normalized intensity, not probability
classification_score_kind: Sigmoid output, weighted BCE not automatically calibrated
limitations: Only one shared held-out patient; not patient-level statistical evidence of general superiority
Training data, sampling, objectives and validation splits differ: not a controlled loss/architecture ablation
Expanded negative labels can include technical staining/preprocessing failures; require QC

binary_dataset.labels: uint8 0/1, lossless packed storage; use BinaryTargetStore.read
binary_dataset.original_target_path_column: provenance only; binary loader overrides intensity targets
